verdict.rationale: Teams platform documentation has a dedicated 'Agent slash commands' page under agents-in-teams, which points to a first-party capability for agents to expose slash commands. The pack contains only the navigation titles, though, so registration mechanics and message-box invocation are not shown. missing for 10: documented details of how developers register or declare custom slash commands (manifest or API), confirmation that users invoke them from the message box, scope (chats, channels or agents only), and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can register custom slash commands that users invoke from the message box
